name: Attempt Labeler
description: places a fun label where you last died

max-labels.name: Max Labels
max-labels.description: the maximum number of labels that can be displayed at once.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: Changes the scale of each label

y-offset.name: Y Offset
y-offset.description: The offset on the y-axis that the label will display at based on the player's coordinates at death (higher = above player, lower = below player).
